{"content":"1|#!/bin/sh
2|# Mount physical-seed roots after Incus API readiness, then start only ready
3|# session instances (including the fixed chatbot alias). Staging names remain
4|# stopped. This is storage
5|# readiness, without a bridge/lungs dependency. A service restart observes
6|# running instances without stopping them; finish never detaches their roots.
7|exec 2>&1
8|rm -f /run/opdbus/runit-ready/identity-roots
9|
10|wait_dep() {
11|    sv start "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
12|    i=0
13|    until sv check "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; do
14|        i=$((i + 1))
15|        [ "$i" -ge 90 ] && { echo "dependency $1 not ready after 90s" >&2; exit 1; }
16|        sleep 1
17|    done
18|}
19|
20|wait_dep incus
21|
22|i=0
23|until incus info >/dev/null 2>&1; do
24|    i=$((i + 1))
25|    if [ "$i" -ge 60 ]; then
26|        echo "incusd API not ready" >&2
27|        exit 1
28|    fi
29|    sleep 1
30|done
31|
32|helper=/usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root
33|gpt=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/.provisioning/3tchedChatbot.boot.json
34|gpt_present=0
35|failed=0
36|if [ -e "$gpt" ] || [ -L "$gpt" ]; then
37|    # Presence selects the GPT owner even when its receipt is invalid. Never
38|    # fall back to a second chatbot root or to direct legacy seed mounts.
39|    gpt_present=1
40|    /usr/local/libexec/3tched/restore-chatbot-root || failed=$((failed + 1))
41|fi
42|physical=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
43|legacy=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
44|physical_present=0
45|seed_readonly_ready=0
46|for receipt in "$physical"/*/state.json; do
47|    [ -e "$receipt" ] || [ -L "$receipt" ] || continue
48|    physical_present=1
49|    name=$(basename "$(dirname "$receipt")")
50|    if [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
51|        case "$name" in 3tchedChatbot|b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28)
52|            echo "physical seed $name: suppressed by GPT boot receipt"
53|            continue ;;
54|        esac
55|    fi
56|    if [ "$name" != 3tchedChatbot ] && ! printf '%s' "$name" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'; then
57|        echo "physical seed staging receipt $name: boot disabled"
58|        continue
59|    fi
60|    marker="$physical/$name/boot-ready.json"
61|    if [ ! -e "$marker" ] && [ ! -L "$marker" ]; then
62|        echo "physical seed $name: no authoritative-completion boot opt-in; skipped"
63|        continue
64|    fi
65|    # A canonical name alone does not prove provisioning completed. The helper
66|    # checks the owner attestation marker and all storage/native identity pins.
67|    if ! jq -e --arg name "$name" '
68|        .name == $name and .phase == "ready" and
69|        (.session == $name or ($name == "3tchedChatbot" and .session == "b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28"))
70|    ' "$receipt" >/dev/null; then
71|        echo "physical seed $name: invalid/incomplete receipt; legacy suppressed" >&2
72|        failed=$((failed + 1))
73|        continue
74|    fi
75|    start_on_boot=$(jq -er '.start_on_boot | select(type == "boolean") | tostring' "$marker") || {
76|        echo "physical seed $name: invalid boot completion policy" >&2
77|        failed=$((failed + 1))
78|        continue
79|    }
80|    # The physical partition's kernel RO flag is volatile across reboot.
81|    # The host owner restores it once, after ready/opt-in selection and before
82|    # any seed-check/up; verification failures stop boot restoration closed.
83|    if [ "$seed_readonly_ready" -eq 0 ]; then
84|        "$helper" seed-readonly || { echo "physical seed read-only enforcement failed" >&2; exit 1; }
85|        seed_readonly_ready=1
86|    fi
87|    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$name/state" | jq -er '.status') || state=unknown
88|    case "$state" in
89|        Running)
90|            if "$helper" seed-check "$name"; then
91|                "$helper" seed-lungs "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
92|            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
93|            ;;
94|        Stopped)
95|            if "$helper" seed-up "$name" && "$helper" seed-lungs "$name"; then
96|                if [ "$start_on_boot" = true ]; then incus start "$name" || failed=$((failed + 1))
97|                else echo "physical seed $name: storage restored; boot start disabled"; fi
98|            else failed=$((failed + 1)); fi
99|            ;;
100|        *) echo "physical seed $name: unsupported native status $state" >&2
101|            failed=$((failed + 1)) ;;
102|    esac
103|done
104|if [ "$physical_present" -eq 1 ] || [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
105|    # A direct legacy lower mount conflicts with sprouts from the SAME seed,
106|    # even for a different identity. Do not invoke legacy `up` in this mode.
107|    for image in "$legacy"/*/identity.img; do
108|        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
109|        name=$(basename "$(dirname "$image")")
110|        if [ "$gpt_present" -eq 1 ]; then
111|            case "$name" in 3tchedChatbot|b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28)
112|                echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by GPT boot receipt"
113|                continue ;;
114|            esac
115|        fi
116|        if [ -e "$physical/$name/state.json" ] || [ -L "$physical/$name/state.json" ]; then
117|            echo "legacy identity $name: suppressed by physical seed receipt"
118|        else
119|            echo "legacy identity $name: migration or independent lower required; shared seed direct mount suppressed" >&2
120|            failed=$((failed + 1))
121|        fi
122|    done
123|else
124|    "$helper" up || failed=$((failed + 1))
125|    "$helper" status || failed=$((failed + 1))
126|fi
127|[ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || { echo "$failed identity root startup check(s) failed" >&2; exit 1; }
128|/usr/local/libexec/3tched/runit-ready-signal identity-roots || exit 1
129|exec sleep infinity","total_lines":129,"file_size":5464,"truncated":false,"is_binary":false,"is_image":false,"not_found":false}

{"content":"45|# host FUSE mount at /run/mount/3tchedFS on every start.
46|# The 3tched-lungs profile provides /run tmpfs and the dedicated host socket
47|# directory at the same /run/opdbus/lungs path inside each new container.
48|# Failures retain native/storage intent and private sanitized receipts.
49|# Host helper/catalog defaults select activated release artifacts.
50|# Selected overrides must be root-controlled. This is host operator maintenance,
51|# not a guest-accessible host socket or a new identity minting authority.
52|# --system uses the mounted Incus plugin in the local default project. Existing
53|# external grants are preserved; this script never assigns principal groups.
54|set -euo pipefail
55|die() { printf 'ERROR: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
56|need_cmd() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing command: $1"; }
57|usage() { sed -n '2,20p' "$0"; }
58|if [[ $# == 0 || ${1:-} == -h || ${1:-} == --help ]]; then usage; exit 0; fi
59|prepare_chatbot_container() (
60|    # Host preparation only: no identity adoption, root copy, device-add or start.
61|    [[ $# == 1 && $1 == 3tchedChatbot ]] || die 'usage: --prepare-container 3tchedChatbot'
62|    [[ $(id -u) == 0 ]] || die 'container preparation requires host root'
63|    for tool in incus jq findmnt stat flock realpath sync; do need_cmd "$tool"; done
64|    incus() { command incus --force-local "$@"; }
65|    umask 077
66|    pool_root=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool
67|    receipt=$pool_root/.provisioning/$1.json
68|    container_receipt=$pool_root/.provisioning/$1.incus.json
69|    [[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool_root" -o FSROOT) == /@3tched-leaf-pool &&
70|       -f $receipt && ! -L $receipt && ! -e $container_receipt && ! -L $container_receipt ]] ||
71|        die 'prepared disk receipt required; existing container intents must be reconciled manually'
72|    jq -e --arg name "$1" '.name==$name and .phase=="filesystems-prepared" and
73|        .layout=="raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1" and .filesystem_prepared==true and .identity_registered==false' \
74|        "$receipt" >/dev/null || die 'disk is not ready for container definition'
75|    image=$(jq -er .image "$receipt")
76|    [[ $image == "$pool_root/$1.img" && -f $image && ! -L $image &&
77|       $(stat -c %i "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_inode "$receipt")" &&
78|       $(stat -c %s "$image") == "$(jq -r .image_bytes "$receipt")" ]] || die 'prepared image changed'
79|    exec 9>"$pool_root/.provisioning/$1.lock"
80|    flock -n 9 || die 'instance preparation active'
81|    instances=$(incus list -f json)
82|    jq -e --arg name "$1" 'type=="array" and all(.[]; .name!=$name)' <<<"$instances" >/dev/null ||
83|        die 'container already exists; never recreate it'
84|    [[ $(findmnt -rn -M /var/lib/incus-storage -o FSROOT) == /@incus ]] || die 'Incus subvolume not mounted'
85|    pool_source=/var/lib/incus-storage/identity-roots
86|    pools=$(incus storage list -f json)
87|    if jq -e 'any(.[]; .name=="identity-roots")' <<<"$pools" >/dev/null; then
88|        pool_json=$(incus query /1.0/storage-pools/identity-roots)
89|        jq -e --arg source "$pool_source" '.driver=="dir" and .status=="Created" and .config.source==$source' \
90|            <<<"$pool_json" >/dev/null || die 'identity-roots pool differs'
91|    else
92|        [[ ! -e /var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots &&
93|           ! -L /var/lib/incus/storage-pools/identity-roots &&
94|           ! -e $pool_source && ! -L $pool_source ]] || die 'retained pool paths require manual reconciliation'
95|        mkdir -m 0711 "$pool_source"
96|        incus storage create identity-roots dir "source=$pool_source"
97|    fi
98|    OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=${OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers/op-identity-image} \
99|        "${OP_IDENTITY_ROOT_HELPER:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/helpers/op-identity-root}" seed-profile
100|    sid=b0c777e3-0955-cd8b-3d01-ca12998cae28
101|    public_key=[REDACTED:opaque-base64]
102|    jq -n --arg name "$1" --arg sid "$sid" --arg source "$pool_source" \
103|        '{version:1,phase:"container-create-intent",name:$name,session_id:$sid,pool_source:$source,
104|          identity_registered:false,root_bound:false,started:false}' > "$container_receipt"
105|    sync -f "$container_receipt"
106|    deny_policy=$(printf '%s\n' \
107|        'ioctl errno 1 [1,0x4008941a,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]' \
108|        'ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000940f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]' \
109|        'ioctl errno 1 [1,0x5000943f,SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ,0xffffffff]')
110|    incus init --empty "$1" --storage identity-roots --profile 3tched-lungs \
111|        --config security.privileged=false --config security.nesting=false \
112|        --config security.protection.shift=true --config boot.autostart=false \
113|        --config security.syscalls.deny_default=true --config "security.syscalls.deny=$deny_policy" \
114|        --config "user.opdbus.session_id=$sid" --config "user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key=$public_key" \
115|        --config user.display_name=control-plane-chatbot --config "raw.lxc=lxc.uts.name = $sid" </dev/null
116|    # Preserve the shared profile. Its historical initial.mode key is absent
117|    # from the sealed disk-device contract and /run already exists as 0755.
118|    incus config device override "$1" runtime-run
119|    incus config device unset "$1" runtime-run initial.mode
120|    instance=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$1")
121|    jq -e --arg name "$1" --arg sid "$sid" '.name==$name and .status=="Stopped" and
122|        .config["user.opdbus.session_id"]==$sid' <<<"$instance" >/dev/null || die 'stopped definition readback differs'
123|    jq --argjson instance "$instance" '.phase="container-defined"|.instance=$instance' \
124|        "$container_receipt" > "$container_receipt.new"
125|    sync -f "$container_receipt.new"
126|    mv -T "$container_receipt.new" "$container_receipt"
127|    sync -f "$pool_root/.provisioning"
128|    printf 'Stopped container defined; root binding and identity adoption remain pending.\n'
129|)
130|case $1 in
131|    --prepare-adoption)
132|        shift
133|        script_dir=$(dirname -- "$(realpath -e -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")
134|        adoption_helper=$script_dir/prepare-chatbot-adoption.sh
135|        [[ -x $adoption_helper ]] || adoption_helper=$script_dir/prepare-chatbot-adoption
136|        [[ -x $adoption_helper ]] || die 'adoption plan helper missing'
137|        exec "$adoption_helper" "$@"
138|        ;;

{"content":"1|//! Fresh same-key adoption of an externally prepared shared-seed container.
2|//! The owner verifies native/storage state and performs only an atomic identity commit.
3|use super::*;
4|use anyhow::{Result, ensure};
5|use op_cozo_store::{CleanProvisionReceipt, IdentityCleanProvision};
6|use op_plugins::state_plugins::{identity_sled::SledBtrfsDevice, incus::IncusRootRepairBackend};
7|use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
8|use std::{
9|    collections::BTreeMap,
10|    path::{Component, Path},
11|};
12|
13|#[path = "identity_clean_provision/storage.rs"]
14|mod storage;
15|
16|const PLAN_DIR: &str = "/var/lib/op-dbus/identity-provision-plans";
17|const MEMBERS: [&str; 7] = [
18|    "@",
19|    "@agent_memory",
20|    "@agent_rules",
21|    "@agent_shared",
22|    "@agent_skills",
23|    "@agent_soul",
24|    "@agent_user",
25|];
26|
27|#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
28|#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
29|struct MemberPin {
30|    id: u64,
31|    uuid: String,
32|}
33|
34|#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
35|#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
36|struct PartitionPin {
37|    partuuid: String,
38|    start_sector: u64,
39|    sectors: u64,
40|}
41|
42|#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
43|#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
44|struct PartitionedOverlay {
45|    disk_guid: String,
46|    root_partition: PartitionPin,
47|    upgrade_partition: PartitionPin,
48|    upgrade_fsid: String,
49|    host_upgrade_fsid: String,
50|}
51|
52|#[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
53|#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
54|struct CleanPlan {
55|    version: u8,
56|    session_id: String,
57|    wireguard_pubkey: String,
58|    expected_revision: u64,
59|    expected_revision_operation_id: String,
60|    binding: SledBtrfsDevice,
61|    seed_device: String,
62|    seed_fsid: String,
63|    seed_generation: u64,
64|    leaf_inode: u64,
65|    leaf_size: u64,
66|    members: BTreeMap<String, MemberPin>,
67|    persist_inode: u64,
68|    native_root: String,
69|    pool_name: String,
70|    pool_source: String,
71|    instance_etag: String,
72|    instance: JsonValue,
73|    previous_instance_etag: String,
74|    previous_instance: JsonValue,
75|    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
76|    partitioned_overlay: Option<PartitionedOverlay>,
77|}
78|
79|fn canonical(path: &str) -> bool {
80|    Path::new(path).is_absolute()
81|        && Path::new(path)
82|            .components()
83|            .all(|p| matches!(p, Component::RootDir | Component::Normal(_)))
84|}
85|fn native_uuid(instance: &JsonValue) -> Result<&str> {
86|    let value = instance["config"]["volatile.uuid"]
87|        .as_str()
88|        .context("native UUID missing")?;
89|    ensure!(
90|        uuid::Uuid::parse_str(value)?.to_string() == value,
91|        "native UUID is noncanonical"
92|    );
93|    Ok(value)
94|}
95|fn canonical_key(key: &str) -> Result<()> {
96|    let decoded = base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.decode(key)?;
97|    ensure!(
98|        decoded.len() == 32 && base64::engine::general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(decoded) == key,
99|        "noncanonical public key"
100|    );
101|    Ok(())
102|}
103|
104|impl CleanPlan {
105|    fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {
106|        canonical_key(&self.wireguard_pubkey)?;
107|        ensure!(
108|            matches!(self.version, 2 | 3 | 4)
109|                && self.session_id
110|                    == op_identity::session::derive_session_id(&self.wireguard_pubkey)
111|                && control_plane_chatbot_session_id().as_deref() == Some(self.session_id.as_str())
112|                && configured_chatbot_key().as_deref() == Some(self.wireguard_pubkey.as_str()),
113|            "clean adoption is only for the configured chatbot key"
114|        );
115|        if self.version == 4 {
116|            let layout = self.partitioned_overlay.as_ref().context("partitioned overlay pins absent")?;
117|            let root = &layout.root_partition;
118|            let upgrade = &layout.upgrade_partition;
119|            ensure!(self.binding.device_path == "/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/3tchedChatbot.img"
120|                && self.binding.mount_point == "/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool/.mounts/3tchedChatbot/root"
121|                && root.start_sector == 2048 && root.sectors >= 2_097_152
122|                && root.start_sector.checked_add(root.sectors) == Some(upgrade.start_sector)
123|                && upgrade.sectors >= 2_097_152
124|                && upgrade.start_sector.checked_add(upgrade.sectors)
125|                    == self.leaf_size.checked_div(512).and_then(|sectors| sectors.checked_sub(2048))
126|                && self.leaf_size % 512 == 0,
127|                "partition geometry or external mount paths differ");
128|            let mut uuids = HashSet::new();
129|            for value in [&layout.disk_guid, &root.partuuid, &upgrade.partuuid, &layout.upgrade_fsid,
130|                &layout.host_upgrade_fsid, &self.seed_fsid, &self.binding.btrfs_uuid] {
131|                ensure!(uuid::Uuid::parse_str(value)?.to_string() == *value && uuids.insert(value),
132|                    "partition or filesystem identities are invalid or reused");
133|            }
134|            ensure!(layout.host_upgrade_fsid == "5a88e7cd-9701-40a7-8301-ef076761886c",
135|                "host upgrade identity differs");
136|        } else {
137|            ensure!(self.partitioned_overlay.is_none(), "legacy plan includes partitioned layout");
138|        }
139|        ensure!(
140|            self.binding.cozo_id == self.session_id
141|                && self.binding.attached
142|                && self.leaf_inode > 0
143|                && self.leaf_size >= 1024 * 1024 * 1024
144|                && self.persist_inode > 256
145|                && self.seed_generation > 0
146|                && !self.instance_etag.is_empty(),
147|            "invalid clean storage/native provenance"
148|        );
149|        for path in [
150|            &self.seed_device,
151|            &self.binding.device_path,
152|            &self.binding.mount_point,
153|            &self.native_root,
154|            &self.pool_source,
155|        ] {
156|            ensure!(canonical(path), "noncanonical clean plan path");
157|        }
158|        ensure!(
159|            self.seed_device.starts_with("/dev/")
160|                && !self.binding.device_path.starts_with("/dev/")
161|                && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&self.seed_fsid)?.to_string() == self.seed_fsid
162|                && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&self.binding.btrfs_uuid)?.to_string()
163|                    == self.binding.btrfs_uuid
164|                && self.seed_fsid != self.binding.btrfs_uuid,
165|            "invalid shared seed/leaf identities"
166|        );
167|        ensure!(
168|            self.members.len() == 7 && MEMBERS.iter().all(|name| self.members.contains_key(*name)),
169|            "clean plan requires exactly seven inherited siblings"
170|        );
171|        let mut ids = HashSet::new();
172|        let mut uuids = HashSet::new();
173|        for pin in self.members.values() {
174|            ensure!(
175|                pin.id >= 256
176|                    && uuid::Uuid::parse_str(&pin.uuid)?.to_string() == pin.uuid
177|                    && ids.insert(pin.id)
178|                    && uuids.insert(&pin.uuid),
179|                "invalid inherited member identities"
180|            );
181|        }
182|        ensure!(
183|            self.pool_name == "identity-roots"
184|                && self.native_root
185|                    == format!(
186|                        "/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/{}/containers/{}/rootfs",
187|                        self.pool_name, CONTROL_PLANE_CHATBOT_CONTAINER
188|                    )
189|                && (self.version != 4 || self.pool_source == "/var/lib/incus-storage/identity-roots")
190|                && self.instance["name"] == CONTROL_PLANE_CHATBOT_CONTAINER
191|                && self.instance["type"] == "container"
192|                && self.instance["status"] == "Stopped"
193|                && self.instance["status_code"] == 102,
194|            "clean plan requires the stopped fresh native container"
195|        );
196|        native_uuid(&self.instance)?;
197|        if self.version == 2 {
198|            ensure!(
199|                !self.previous_instance_etag.is_empty()
200|                    && self.previous_instance["type"] == "container"
201|                    && self.previous_instance["status"] == "Stopped"
202|                    && self.previous_instance["name"] != self.instance["name"]
203|                    && native_uuid(&self.instance)? != native_uuid(&self.previous_instance)?,
204|                "replacement requires distinct stopped native containers"
205|            );
206|        } else {
207|            ensure!(
208|                self.previous_instance.is_null() && self.previous_instance_etag.is_empty(),
209|                "post-deletion provision must not import the previous native record"
210|            );
211|        }
212|        ensure!(
213|            self.instance["profiles"] == serde_json::json!(["3tched-lungs"]),
214|            "unexpected fresh native profiles"
215|        );
216|        for config_field in ["config", "expanded_config"] {
217|            let config = self.instance[config_field]
218|                .as_object()
219|                .context("native config absent")?;
220|            ensure!(
221|                config
222|                    .get("security.privileged")
223|                    .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)
224|                    == Some("false")
225|                    && config.get("security.nesting").and_then(JsonValue::as_str) == Some("false")

{"content":"1|#!/usr/bin/env bash
2|# Completed manual provisioning step: one sparse disk, root + upgrade partitions.
3|# Storage preparation only; identity registration and container startup are separate.
4|set -euo pipefail
5|fail() { printf 'prepare-instance-disk: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
6|usage() {
7|    cat <<'USAGE'
8|Usage:
9|  prepare-instance-disk create NAME [--root-gib N] [--upgrade-gib N]
10|  prepare-instance-disk inspect NAME
11|  prepare-instance-disk prepare NAME --seed-device /dev/disk/by-uuid/UUID
12|
13|Pool: /var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool (mounted @3tched-leaf-pool)
14|Image: NAME.img, sparse raw, GPT root + upgrade partitions
15|Defaults: 20 GiB root, remaining approximately 40 GiB upgrade.
16|Existing images are never adopted, repartitioned or overwritten by create.
17|inspect reads the image and reports its partition table; it does not modify it.
18|USAGE
19|}
20|[[ $# -gt 0 ]] || { usage; exit 2; }
21|case $1 in -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;; esac
22|[[ $# -ge 2 ]] || fail 'action and instance name required'
23|action=$1 name=$2
24|shift 2
25|[[ $action == create || $action == inspect || $action == prepare ]] || fail 'unknown action'
26|[[ $name =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$ ]] || fail 'invalid instance name'
27|root_gib=20 upgrade_gib=40 seed_device=
28|while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
29|    [[ $action != inspect ]] || fail 'inspect takes no options'
30|    [[ $# -ge 2 ]] || fail "missing value for $1"
31|    case $1 in
32|        --root-gib) [[ $action == create ]] || fail 'size applies to create'; root_gib=$2 ;;
33|        --upgrade-gib) [[ $action == create ]] || fail 'size applies to create'; upgrade_gib=$2 ;;
34|        --seed-device) [[ $action == prepare ]] || fail 'seed applies to prepare'; seed_device=$2 ;;
35|        *) fail "unknown option: $1" ;;
36|    esac
37|    shift 2
38|done
39|[[ $(id -u) == 0 ]] || fail 'host root owns disk preparation'
40|for tool in qemu-img sfdisk jq findmnt realpath stat flock date sync; do
41|    command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || fail "missing $tool"
42|done
43|for size in "$root_gib" "$upgrade_gib"; do
44|    [[ $size =~ ^[1-9][0-9]{0,3}$ ]] && (( size <= 1024 )) || fail 'partition size must be 1 to 1024 GiB'
45|done
46|pool=/var/lib/3tched-leaf-pool
47|[[ -d $pool && ! -L $pool && $(realpath -e "$pool") == "$pool" ]] || fail 'leaf pool is absent or noncanonical'
48|[[ $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSTYPE) == btrfs && $(findmnt -rn -M "$pool" -o FSROOT) == /@3tched-leaf-pool ]] || fail 'expected mounted @3tched-leaf-pool; refusing a root-directory fallback'
49|[[ $(stat -c '%u %a' "$pool") == '0 700' ]] || fail 'leaf pool must be root-owned mode 0700'
50|image=$pool/$name.img
51|if [[ $action == inspect ]]; then
52|    [[ -f $image && ! -L $image ]] || fail 'image is absent or not a regular file'
53|    qemu-img info -f raw --output=json "$image"
54|    sfdisk --json "$image"
55|    exit 0
56|fi
57|umask 077
58|receipt_root=$pool/.provisioning
59|[[ ! -L $receipt_root ]] || fail 'receipt directory is a symlink'
60|mkdir -p -- "$receipt_root"
61|[[ $(stat -c '%u %a' "$receipt_root") == '0 700' ]] || fail 'receipt directory must be root-owned mode 0700'
62|lock=$receipt_root/$name.lock
63|[[ ! -L $lock && ( ! -e $lock || -f $lock ) ]] || fail 'invalid instance lock'
64|exec 9>"$lock"
65|flock -n 9 || fail 'another preparation owns this instance'
66|receipt=$receipt_root/$name.json
67|if [[ $action == prepare ]]; then
68|    for tool in losetup blkid blockdev btrfs mkfs.btrfs mount umount rg sed install; do
69|        command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || fail "missing $tool"
70|    done
71|    [[ $seed_device == /dev/disk/by-uuid/* && -b $seed_device ]] || fail 'stable seed UUID path required'
72|    [[ -f $image && ! -L $image && -f $receipt && ! -L $receipt ]] || fail 'disk and creation receipt required'
73|    jq -e --arg image "$image" --arg name "$name" --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$image")" \
74|        --argjson bytes "$(stat -c %s "$image")" \
75|        '.phase=="disk-partitioned" and .image==$image and .name==$name and
76|         .image_inode==$inode and .image_bytes==$bytes and .identity_registered==false' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'not a fresh partitioned disk; never repeat device-add'
77|    table=$(sfdisk --json "$image")
78|    jq -e --argjson actual "$table" '.partition_table==$actual.partitiontable and
79|        (.partition_table.partitions|length)==2' "$receipt" >/dev/null || fail 'partition table differs from receipt'
80|    [[ -z $(losetup -j "$image") ]] || fail 'image already attached'
81|    seed_fsid=$(blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$seed_device")
82|    [[ $seed_device == /dev/disk/by-uuid/"$seed_fsid" ]] || fail 'seed UUID mismatch'
83|    btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device" | sed -n '/flags/,/fsid/p' | rg -q SEEDING || fail 'seed is not sealed'
84|    root_mount=$pool/.mounts/$name/root
85|    upgrade_mount=$pool/.mounts/$name/upgrade
86|    [[ ! -e $pool/.mounts/$name ]] || fail 'mount directory already exists'
87|    phase() {
88|        jq --arg phase "$1" '.phase=$phase' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
89|        mv -T "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
90|        sync -f "$receipt_root"
91|    }
92|    phase filesystem-prepare-intent
93|    mkdir -p "$root_mount" "$upgrade_mount"
94|    blockdev --setro "$seed_device"
95|    seed_loop=$(losetup --find --show --read-only "$seed_device")
96|    disk_loop=$(losetup --find --show --partscan "$image")
97|    root_partition=${disk_loop}p1 upgrade_partition=${disk_loop}p2
98|    jq --arg seed "$seed_device" --arg sf "$seed_fsid" --arg sl "$seed_loop" --arg dl "$disk_loop" \
99|        --arg rp "$root_partition" --arg up "$upgrade_partition" --arg rm "$root_mount" --arg um "$upgrade_mount" \
100|        '.seed_device=$seed|.seed_fsid=$sf|.seed_loop=$sl|.disk_loop=$dl|
101|         .root_partition=$rp|.upgrade_partition=$up|.root_mount=$rm|.upgrade_mount=$um' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
102|    mv -T "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
103|    for partition in "$root_partition" "$upgrade_partition"; do
104|        [[ -b $partition && -z $(blkid -p -s TYPE -o value "$partition" || true) ]] || fail 'partition is not blank'
105|    done
106|    mount -o ro,subvolid=5 "$seed_loop" "$root_mount"
107|    for member in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
108|        btrfs subvolume show "$root_mount/$member" >/dev/null || fail "seed missing $member"
109|    done
110|    phase root-device-add-intent
111|    btrfs device add "$root_partition" "$root_mount"
112|    sync -f "$root_mount"
113|    umount "$root_mount"
114|    mount -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_loop,device=$root_partition" "$root_partition" "$root_mount"
115|    phase upgrade-format-intent
116|    mkfs.btrfs -L 3tched-upgrade "$upgrade_partition"
117|    mount -o rw,subvolid=5 "$upgrade_partition" "$upgrade_mount"
118|    btrfs subvolume create "$upgrade_mount/@"
119|    for member in @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_skills @agent_user; do
120|        btrfs property set -ts "$root_mount/$member" ro false
121|    done
122|    for member in @agent_shared @agent_soul; do
123|        btrfs property set -ts "$root_mount/$member" ro true
124|    done
125|    install -d -m 0700 "$root_mount/@agent_user/persist"
126|    install -d -m 0755 "$root_mount/@/opt/run-mounts/persist"
127|    sync -f "$root_mount"
128|    sync -f "$upgrade_mount"
129|    jq --arg rf "$(blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$root_partition")" \
130|        --arg uf "$(blkid -p -s UUID -o value "$upgrade_partition")" \
131|        '.root_fsid=$rf|.upgrade_fsid=$uf|.filesystem_prepared=true|.phase="filesystems-prepared"' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
132|    mv -T "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
133|    sync -f "$receipt_root"
134|    printf 'Filesystems prepared; mounts retained for next manual step. Receipt: %s\n' "$receipt"
135|    exit 0
136|fi
137|[[ ! -e $image && ! -L $image ]] || fail 'image already exists; use inspect, never repeat creation'
138|receipt=$receipt_root/$name.json
139|[[ ! -e $receipt && ! -L $receipt ]] || fail 'retained preparation intent exists; inspect before any retry'
140|total_gib=$((root_gib + upgrade_gib))
141|created_at=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
142|jq -n --arg name "$name" --arg image "$image" --arg pool "$pool" --arg time "$created_at" \
143|    --argjson root "$root_gib" --argjson upgrade "$upgrade_gib" --argjson total "$total_gib" \
144|    '{version:1,layout:"raw-gpt-root-upgrade-v1",phase:"disk-create-intent",
145|      name:$name,image:$image,pool:$pool,created_at:$time,
146|      root_gib:$root,upgrade_gib_requested:$upgrade,total_gib:$total,
147|      identity_registered:false,filesystem_prepared:false}' > "$receipt"
148|# qemu-img creates a sparse raw disk; GPT/alignment overhead reduces partition 2
149|# slightly. All commands address only the newly created image, never a host disk.
150|qemu-img create -f raw "$image" "${total_gib}G"
151|chmod 0600 "$image"
152|sfdisk "$image" <<PARTITIONS
153|label: gpt
154|unit: sectors
155|
156|size=${root_gib}G, type=L, name="3tched-root"
157|type=L, name="3tched-upgrade"
158|PARTITIONS
159|partition_table=$(sfdisk --json "$image")
160|# Pin partition identities now; loop numbers are runtime attachments, not owners.
161|jq --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$image")" --argjson bytes "$(stat -c %s "$image")" \
162|    --argjson partition_table "$partition_table" \
163|    '.phase="disk-partitioned" | .image_inode=$inode | .image_bytes=$bytes |
164|     .partition_table=$partition_table.partitiontable' "$receipt" > "$receipt.new"
165|mv -T -- "$receipt.new" "$receipt"
166|sync -f "$pool"
167|printf 'Prepared disk: %s\nReceipt: %s\n' "$image" "$receipt"
168|printf '%s\n' 'No filesystems formatted, container created, seed attached, or Cozo binding committed.'","total_lines":168,"file_size":9207,"truncated":false,"is_binary":false,"is_image":false,"not_found":false}
